name: Sunrise Salon
description: a small hair salon in the city
greeting: Thanks for calling Sunrise Salon. I'm the AI assistant. How can I help you today?
urgentRules: emergencies or safety issues, a customer with a time-critical problem today, an angry customer threatening to cancel or complain, or someone saying it is urgent

faqs.a: Prices depend on the service. I can take your details and the owner will send a quote.

faqs.q: Do you take walk-ins or appointments?
faqs.a: Both. Appointments are preferred; I can take a message to arrange one.

faqs.q: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: Cash, all major cards and UPI.
